question: Compare our suppliers — who is the most reliable?
agent_answer:
Here's the full supplier reliability ranking, based on SRM data:

| Rank | Supplier | Rating | On-Time Rate | Avg Lead (vs declared) | Orders |
|------|----------|--------|--------------|------------------------|--------|
| 1 | **SUP-001 Somchai Mango Farm** | 4.5 | **100%** (13/13) | 2.9 days vs 3 declared | 14 |
| 2 | **SUP-004 Rayong Tropical** | 4.0 | **100%** (6/6) | 2.8 days vs 3 declared | 7 |
| 3 | SUP-005 Isaan Organic Farms | 3.5 | 33% (3/9) | 7.1 days vs 6 declared | 10 |
| 4 | SUP-002 Northern Fruits Co. | 3.2 | 24% (4/17) | 6.3 days vs 5 declared | 19 |
| 5 | SUP-003 Prachuap Harvest | 2.8 | 25% (2/8) | 5.1 days vs 4 declared | 10 |

**Key findings:**

- **Somchai Mango Farm (SUP-001)** is the clear #1 — perfect on-time rate across 14 orders (the largest sample size), fastest average lead time, and highest rating (4.5). Best choice for premium and standard products.
- **Rayong Tropical (SUP-004)** also shows 100% on-time, but on only 7 orders — solid but smaller track record. Only supplier for processed products.
- **Suppliers 2, 3, and 5 are underperforming** — all averaging 24–33% on-time and consistently delivering later than their declared lead times. SUP-002 is the most frequently used despite being one of the worst performers.

**Recommendation:** Prioritize SUP-001 for premium/standard restocking. Investigate whether SUP-002's high order volume is justified given its poor reliability — it may be a cost decision worth revisiting.
